quests.title: This is an example Quest
quests.notes: A Quest is the top-level goal. It only becomes done via confirm_completion, once every Mission below it is done and confirmed too.

quests.title: This is an example Mission under that Quest
quests.notes: A Mission belongs to a Quest via parentId. Its own status still cycles idea/progress/blocked freely until every Task under it is done.

quests.title: This is an example Task under that Mission
quests.notes: Tasks are leaves -- no children of their own.
